title: fix(lint, runtime)!: an action body that cannot compile in its (input, ctx) wrapper is refused at validate, build and publish, and at run time answers naming itself
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziunkXbDT7wUWqfmWz

Fixes #34884

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — an L2 action body (`type: 'script'`, `body.language: 'js'`) that does not compile as the body of `(async (input, ctx) => { … })` passed `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint`, `os verify` and the runtime publish door; it is now refused there as `action-body-does-not-compile` at `error` (on the publish door for `action` writes and for `object` writes carrying inline `actions[]`). One arm advises instead of refusing: a regular-expression literal the host engine refuses is a `warning`. Such a body never ran: every run failed with a SyntaxError before its first statement. `@objectstack/lint` also gains exports (`validateActionBodyCompiles`, `hostCompileFailure`, `ACTION_BODY_DOES_NOT_COMPILE`, `ACTION_BODY_PARAMETERS`, `actionBodyFunctionExpression` and two finding types on `.`, `actionBodyFunctionExpression` on `./runtime`).
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md (it teaches the action wrap `(async (input, ctx) => { … })` without saying a body must not declare `input` / `ctx` again); follow-up #34988 (blocked on #34504, which holds that file); this PR teaches it in `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` and `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：脚本动作的 `body.source` 如果在运行时的包装 `(async (input, ctx) => { … })` 里编译不过（最常见是 `const input = ctx.input || {}` 重复声明参数），现在 `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` / 发布保存（动作写入和对象写入）都会报错拒绝，点名动作、编译错误和行号；运行时若仍遇到这种动作，REST `/actions` 与 MCP `run_action` 回答 `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`，消息点名动作和编译错误，不再是光秃秃的 "Internal server error"。
- 为什么改：这种动作以前四道门全过，部署后每次运行都失败，调用方（尤其 AI）只看到不透明的 500，只好绕开去直接写数据，把状态弄错。
- 风险与回滚：新拒绝的只有本来就永远跑不起来的动作体；检查用宿主 JS 引擎（Node 的 V8）编译、不执行，与运行时 QuickJS 唯一实测分歧在正则字面量，那一支只给警告不拒绝。四个示例应用实测 0 处命中，全量 dogfood 绿。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.ts`（编译方式与正则分支）；`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`（`actionBodyCompileFailure` 与包装改用共享函数）；`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`（注册：门禁级、发布门 `action` + `object`）。；`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.action-body-does-not-compile-refused.ts`（ADR-0087 语义迁移条目，升级指南与 `os migrate meta` 读它）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-action-body-compiles.test.ts`，预期 14 条全过，其中含卡里那句原样的动作体被拒。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（收窄需一次契约级审查，由席位安排）。

## What changes

- **Author time (`@objectstack/lint`)** — new gating rule `action-body-does-not-compile` (`validate-action-body-compiles.ts`). It compiles each L2 action body inside `actionBodyFunctionExpression(source)`, the wrapper the runtime builds, from the same function, with the host engine, as a script, never running it (`node:vm` `Script`; the `Function` constructor where `node:vm` is absent; no verdict where the host refuses to compile at all). The finding names the action, the compiler's sentence and the line of `body.source`; a redeclared wrapper parameter gets a hint naming it. Registered in `authoring-rules.ts` as `gating` on all three commands and on the runtime publish door for `action` and `object` writes; `os explain action-body-does-not-compile` added; barrel exports added. The object door's roster pin in `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts` names the join.
- **The shared wrapper** — `packages/lint/src/action-body-wrapper.ts` holds the one spelling, `(async (input, ctx) => { SOURCE })`. `quickjs-runner.ts` now builds its action wrapper from it through `@objectstack/lint/runtime` (the runtime already depends on that entry); the wrapper text is byte-identical to before.
- **Run time (`@objectstack/runtime`)** — when evaluating an action's wrapper fails with a `SyntaxError` (a compile failure: an async body cannot throw synchronously, so anything the body itself throws crosses `__error` instead), the runner throws a `SandboxError` with `status: 500`, no code, the operator line `action 'NAME' does not compile: SyntaxError: …` and the caller sentence `Action 'NAME' cannot run: its body does not compile (SyntaxError: …). The action's author must fix its body.source and publish it again.` The doors answer the status's own `INTERNAL_ERROR` and relay that sentence. A crash while running (a `TypeError`, a `SyntaxError` thrown by `JSON.parse`) keeps the sanitised 500. Hook and job bodies are unchanged.
- **Protocol (`@objectstack/spec`)** — the ADR-0087 semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.action-body-does-not-compile-refused.ts` (`action-body-does-not-compile-refused`: surface, replacement, reason, acceptance criteria) registers the narrowing for the upgrade guide and `os migrate meta`; the generated registry picks it up, no other spec file changes. The changeset declares `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, carries `adr-0087: registered action-body-does-not-compile-refused`, and grades `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, `@objectstack/runtime` `patch`.
- **Docs** — `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` teach the rule; `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` gains the Action Errors row; the author-time rule count the CLI prints goes 70 to 71 in the four transcript pages. `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` gains the rule's row in the four-doors table (`✓ ✓ ✓ ✓ᵃᶜᵒ`: the three commands, and the publish door for `action` and `object` writes).

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.test.ts` (14): the card's body byte for byte refused (`error`, path, `'input'`, line 1, parameter hint); the same source compiling in the parse check's own wrapper (why no check saw it); `let ctx` on line 3; an unparseable body; `new.target`; four bodies that compile (`var input`, reading `input`, …) admitted; the regex arm at `warning`; a body that closes the wrapper early compiles and never executes; both registration sites, merged action once, non-script and non-js skipped; `validate` / `build` / `lint` each refuse; the `action` and `object` publish doors refuse and admit; an unrelated write is not charged with a stored bad body.
- `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/sandboxed-action-crash-is-a-fault.test.ts`, new top-level describe (3): the real runner on the card's body (message, `status: 500`, no code, sentence); the real `/actions` door answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with the sentence, not `Internal server error`; control: a runtime `SyntaxError` stays a sanitised crash.
- `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-sandbox-fault-row.test.ts` (round 2): the census that renders every `SandboxError` construction in `quickjs-runner.ts` gains crash samples for the new site's two interpolations, `actionName` and `compilerError`; the census is not loosened, and the new site becomes one more §2 case (the door withholds a sandbox fault's text, the import row reads the door's sentence). Red before on `bc80b37795` (`quickjs-runner.ts:2407 (relayed): no sample for the interpolation actionName`, 1 failed, 44 passed), green after (46 passed).

<details><summary>Live measurement before and after (scratch app, CLI built from this tree)</summary>

Before (origin/main fff0ad0c18), action body `const input = ctx.input || {}; return 1;`:

- `os validate` exit 0, `os build` exit 0, `os verify` exit 0 ("verify passed — no runtime failures").
- REST `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJ/ACTION/ID`: `500 {"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR","message":"Internal server error"}`.
- MCP `run_action`: `{"error":{"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR","message":"Internal server error","status":500}}`.
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/NAME` with that body: `200` saved active.
- Server log: `ERROR [BodyRunner] sandboxed action threw … action 'rpc_decide' threw: SyntaxError: invalid redefinition of parameter name`, then `sandboxed body crashed: …`.
- First door that could see the error and did not: `os validate` (every author-time door shares the registry).

After (this branch, the pre-fix artifact booted with `-a` to stand for a body deployed before the rule):

- `os validate` / `os build` / `os verify` exit 1, `action-body-does-not-compile` at `actions[0].body.source` ("SyntaxError: Identifier 'input' has already been declared, line 1").
- REST and MCP: `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, message `Action 'rpc_decide' cannot run: its body does not compile (SyntaxError: invalid redefinition of parameter name). The action's author must fix its body.source and publish it again.`
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/NAME`: `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the rule's issue; a body using `const params = ctx.input || {}` saves `200`.
- Server log: `action 'rpc_decide' does not compile: SyntaxError: invalid redefinition of parameter name`.
- Control action `return { ok: true }`: `200` both times.
</details>

<details><summary>Engine probe (36 bodies, Node 22 V8 vs the runtime's QuickJS)</summary>

Agreed on every redeclaration, grammar error, strict-mode error, `super` and `new.target` (with the wrapper compiled as a script). Disagreed once: `/(?<a>x)|(?<a>y)/` (duplicate named groups) is refused by Node 22's V8 and accepted by QuickJS, hence the regex `warning` arm.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored to blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- `validate-action-body-compiles.ts`: `if (!failure) continue;` → `if (!failure || site) continue;` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob 9e2fd44dd44c → 1f242fac955b): 9 of 14 red; restored 9e2fd44dd44c.
- `quickjs-runner.ts`: the compile-failure branch disabled (`&& !err`, anchor 1 → 0, blob 571aa67e747d → a06de24caa83): the 2 compile-failure pins red, the control and the 3 earlier cases green; restored 571aa67e747d.
- Both test files import the code under test from `src/` (relative), so no dist rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Metadata-protocol: narrowed** (seat ruling 21:04Z on the round-1 question, option B; claim amendment on #34884): the semantic entry above, in the precedent's shape (`.changeset/34378-lookup-filter-record-path-multi-valued.md`, `.changeset/33435-injected-column-null-guard-at-build.md`): BREAKING scope, FROM → TO, Fix, measured first-party exposure (zero).
- **The object publish door runs the rule too** (`runtimeTypes: ['action', 'object']`, kept by the seat's ruling): an object write carries inline `actions[]`, the second place a body is published, so an object write cannot republish a refused body inline. The publish gate charges a write with every non-compiling inline body the written object carries, changed or not (only another entry's findings cancel), so an object publish is refused while it still carries such a body, a body stored before this rule included; a write of another object is not charged with it (pinned). This is the surface the semantic entry declares. The registration comment in `authoring-rules.ts` still says "only the bodies it adds"; that sentence is left for a later touch of the file (seat contract review 6964237524, N1).
- Hook and job bodies (`(async (ctx) => { … })`) are not judged and their run-time answer is unchanged (seat ruling: they stay out of this PR; follow-up #34987).
- No user-text catalog (`*.user-text.ts`) is authored for the new rule: the publish door renders its `message`.
- Text conflict with open PR #34791 on the four rule-count transcript lines (both bump 70 to 71); whichever lands second re-bumps. No overlap with #34719's lines (`overlap-check`: merges cleanly).
